BDI.note: The RPPCUB is a census of urban property owners, not a population and housing census or household survey.
The document describes an owner enumeration to build a register, with no land information system processing transactions, joining maps or valuation, or linked to tax.

facts.fact: On 2026-07-14 the Prime Minister of Burundi launched the RPPCUB 2026 census of urban property owners, whose stated aim is a fully digitised, geo-referenced land register, starting in Mugere, Mukaza, Ntahangwa, Gitega, Ngozi and Rumonge communes before national roll-out, with enumerators from INSBU working with the land-titles and cadastre directorate (DTFCN).

systems.tiers: six urban communes in first phase

BDI.note: Nothing stated on local government office connections.
